description: The NC FreeEnterprise Foundation (NCFREE) released its 2019 Legislative Business Ratings of the voting records of members of the NC General Assembly as they relate to advancing business and free enterprise opportunities within the state. In the NC House,Majority Leader John Bell (R- Greene, Johnston, Wayne) earned the top spot,along with Rep. Larry Potts (R-Davidson) at 99.1%.
paid_for_by: PAID FOR BY ELECT JOHN BELL COMMITTTEE
title: Majority Leader John Bell Earns Top Pro-Business Voting Record in NC House
